content: Our framework consists of a series of steps for which there are choices and alternatives. Although it is not possible to provide comparisons to the myriad of methods and possibilities available, we have examined quantitatively the robustness of the results to parametric and methodological choices in different steps of the framework: (i) the importance of using Doc2Vec embeddings instead of BoW vectors, (ii) the size of training corpus for Doc2Vec; (iii) the sparsity of the MST-kNN similarity graph construction. We have also carried out quantitative comparisons to other methods, including: (i) LDA-BoW, and (ii) clustering with other community detection methods. We provide a brief summary here and additional material in the SI.
